description: Customer Shopping Preferences Dataset with 3900 records capturing consumer behavior and purchasing patterns.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Gender of the customer. Stored values: 'Male', 'Female'

columns.name: item_purchased
columns.description: The item purchased by the customer

columns.name: category
columns.description: Category of the item purchased (e.g., Clothing, Footwear, Accessories)

columns.name: purchase_amount_usd
columns.description: The amount of the purchase in USD

columns.name: location
columns.description: Location/state where the purchase was made

columns.name: size
columns.description: Size of the purchased item (S, M, L, XL)

columns.name: color
columns.description: Color of the purchased item. Stored values use Title Case e.g. 'Pink', 'Blue', 'Red', 'Green', 'Black', 'White', 'Gray', 'Yellow', 'Purple', 'Orange', 'Brown', 'Beige', 'Cyan', 'Magenta', 'Olive', 'Teal', 'Lavender', 'Maroon', 'Silver', 'Gold'

columns.name: season
columns.description: Season during which the purchase was made. Stored values: 'Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Winter'

columns.name: review_rating
columns.description: Rating given by the customer (1.0 to 5.0)

columns.name: subscription_status
columns.description: Indicates if the customer has a subscription. Stored values: 'Yes', 'No'

columns.name: shipping_type
columns.description: Type of shipping chosen (e.g., Free Shipping, Express, Standard)

columns.name: discount_applied
columns.description: Indicates if a discount was applied. Stored values: 'Yes', 'No'

columns.name: promo_code_used
columns.description: Indicates if a promo code was used. Stored values: 'Yes', 'No'

columns.name: previous_purchases
columns.description: Total count of previous transactions by the customer

columns.name: payment_method
columns.description: Payment method used for the transaction (e.g., Credit Card, PayPal, Cash)

columns.name: preferred_payment_method
columns.description: Customer's most preferred payment method overall (e.g., Credit Card, PayPal, Cash)

columns.name: frequency_of_purchases
columns.description: How often the customer makes purchases (Weekly, Fortnightly, Monthly, Quarterly, Annually, Every 3 Months, Bi-Weekly)

sample_questions: What is the average purchase amount by gender?
Which category has the most purchases?
How many customers use promo codes?
What is the most popular payment method?
Show top 10 customers by previous purchases
What is the average review rating per season?
